about.description:
earthlens is a Python package for downloading satellite and climate
data from multiple sources, including the Climate Hazards Center
(CHIRPS / CHIRP / CHIRTS / WBGT / SPI / SPEI / CHC_CMIP6, via FTP),
ERA5 on AWS S3, the ECMWF Climate Data Store via cdsapi, and Google
Earth Engine. It provides a unified `EarthLens` facade that lazily
loads each backend so the optional SDK for a backend you don't use
never has to be installed.

The core `earthlens` package ships only the CHC (FTP) backend's
requirements. The optional backends are packaged as separate
metapackages that depend on `earthlens` plus the relevant SDK:

  * `earthlens-s3` — boto3 (ERA5-on-S3 backend)
  * `earthlens-ecmwf` — cdsapi (ECMWF/CDS backend)
  * `earthlens-gee` — earthengine-api + rtree (Google Earth Engine)
  * `earthlens-all` — pulls in every optional backend

name: earthlens-split
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set python_min = "3.11" %}
{% set name = "earthlens" %}
{% set version = "0.5.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}-split
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/serapeum-org/earthlens/archive/{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: f501b534c67b21b907a146c95b58af99fb0d417843c0a2bc6a09e3acb46219fd

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  - name: earthlens
    build:
      noarch: python
      script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      host:
        - python {{ python_min }}
        - pip
        - setuptools >=80
        - wheel
      run:
        - python >={{ python_min }}
        - pyramids >=0.19.0
        - joblib >=1.5.0
        - loguru >=0.7.3
        - numpy >=2.0.0
        - pandas >=2.0.0
        - pyyaml >=6.0.2
        - pydantic >=2
        - requests >=2.28.1
        - tqdm >=4.66.0
    test:
      requires:
        - python {{ python_min }}
      imports:
        - earthlens
        - earthlens.aggregate
        - earthlens.base
        - earthlens.chc

  - name: earthlens-s3
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python {{ python_min }}
      run:
        - python >={{ python_min }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('earthlens', exact=True) }}
        - boto3 >=1.43.0
    test:
      requires:
        - python {{ python_min }}
      imports:
        - earthlens.s3

  - name: earthlens-ecmwf
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python {{ python_min }}
      run:
        - python >={{ python_min }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('earthlens', exact=True) }}
        - cdsapi >=0.7.7
    test:
      requires:
        - python {{ python_min }}
      imports:
        - earthlens.ecmwf

  - name: earthlens-gee
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python {{ python_min }}
      run:
        - python >={{ python_min }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('earthlens', exact=True) }}
        - earthengine-api >=1.7.26
        - rtree >=1.0.0
    test:
      requires:
        - python {{ python_min }}
      imports:
        - earthlens.gee

  - name: earthlens-all
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python {{ python_min }}
      run:
        - python >={{ python_min }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('earthlens', exact=True) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('earthlens-s3', exact=True) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('earthlens-ecmwf', exact=True) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('earthlens-gee', exact=True) }}
    test:
      requires:
        - python {{ python_min }}
      imports:
        - earthlens
        - earthlens.s3
        - earthlens.ecmwf
        - earthlens.gee
